source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of prevention techniques (PDF 181).

blocks.text: Online khatron se bachne ke liye alag alag security tools (auzaar) aur practices (achhi aadatein) istemal karna zaroori hai. Yeh tareeqe aap ki personal maloomat mehfooz rakhte hain aur online tajurba zyada mehfooz banate hain. Agle hisson mein paanch tareeqe hain: spam filters, antivirus software, cookie management, phishing pehchanna aur pharming se bachao.

blocks.alt: Do column: baen taraf paanch khatre (Spam, Spyware, Cookies, Phishing, Pharming) aur har ek se teer daen taraf us ke bachao tak: Spam filter, Antivirus software, Cookie management, Phishing ki pehchan, aur https:// aur taala jaanchna.
blocks.caption: Har online khatra aur us ka bachao (hamara banaya hua khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Sirf ek tool par bharosa karne ke bajaye kai tareeqe saath kyun istemal karein?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke har tool alag khatre ke liye hai. Maslan antivirus us phishing email ko nahi rokta jis mein aap khud apna password likh dein; is ke liye phishing pehchanna zaroori hai.

items: Bachao ke tareeqe: spam filters, antivirus, cookie management, phishing pehchanna, pharming se bachao; sab mil kar zyada hifazat dete hain.
